## Imports


::: {#7917de31 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import json
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
```
:::


## Load Metrics

::: {#ce8248b9 .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
metrics_path = Path("results/metrics/train_metrics.json")

if metrics_path.exists():
    with open(metrics_path) as f:
        metrics = json.load(f)
    print("Loaded metrics:", metrics)
else:
    # Placeholder metrics when no experiment has been run yet
    metrics = {
        "train_loss": [1.0, 0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 0.3],
        "val_loss": [1.1, 0.9, 0.7, 0.5, 0.4],
    }
    print("No metrics file found — using placeholder data.")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
No metrics file found — using placeholder data.
```
:::
:::


## Training Curves

::: {#c122c5f7 .cell execution_count=3}
``` {.python .cell-code}
train_loss = metrics.get("train_loss", [])
val_loss = metrics.get("val_loss", [])

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))

if train_loss:
    ax.plot(train_loss, label="Train loss", marker="o")
if val_loss:
    ax.plot(val_loss, label="Val loss", marker="s", linestyle="--")

ax.set_xlabel("Epoch")
ax.set_ylabel("Loss")
ax.set_title("Training Curves")
ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Final Metrics Summary

::: {#54cc641b .cell execution_count=4}
``` {.python .cell-code}
if train_loss:
    print(f"Final train loss: {train_loss[-1]:.4f}")
if val_loss:
    print(f"Final val loss:   {val_loss[-1]:.4f}")

other_metrics = {
    k: v for k, v in metrics.items() if k not in {"train_loss", "val_loss"}
}
for key, value in other_metrics.items():
    print(f"{key}: {value}")
```
